t: The No Nonsense D2 PVA Adhesive is a general-purpose bonding agent designed for a wide range of construction and joinery tasks. This versatile 5Ltr PVA adhesive offers high bond strength, making it suitable for professionals working with wood, cork, paper, and textiles. It is also an excellent choice for bonding cement-based screeds and renders, acting as an effective admixture for mortar, screeds, and renders. This adhesive can also be used as a primer and sealer in tiling applications, providing a reliable base. Its dilution depends on the specific use, ensuring adaptability across various projects.
